plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure. Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet mandate. Add to QQQI for increased income focus. Trim QQQ and SMH to reduce broad index and semiconductor exposure. Buy AAPL as a top-quality name for diversification.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for lower drawdown. Risk is primarily from broad market movements, but individual stock risk is minimized.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It maintains some leverage while reducing overall concentration. Expect moderate swings, with market downturns impacting performance.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases leverage and concentration in high-scoring setups. Be aware of larger drawdowns and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs, requiring strict stop discipline.
